seg.notes: Four reportable segments: Aggregates, Asphalt, Concrete, Calcium (Calcium still reported separately, not folded in). Aggregates revenues include freight & delivery and service revenues; the only intersegment elimination published is 'Aggregates intersegment sales'. Freight & delivery revenues and other revenues are the deductions in the freight-adjusted revenue reconciliation (segment level, incl. intersegment freight). Calcium volume/price no longer published (from Q2-23 release). Volumes published in millions to 1 dp. Asphalt and concrete prices exclude service revenues (footnote 5).

ngaap.notes: New basis from Q2-23: EBITDA = NI attributable to Vulcan + income tax expense INCLUDING discontinued operations + interest + DDA&A; pre-tax loss on discontinued operations is an adjustment in the Adjusted EBITDA bridge (adj_items.disc_ops). Bridge line 'Acquisition related charges' (renamed from 'Business development'); restructuring no longer a separate line. Q2-23 release labels the tax line 'Income tax expense' but the value (90.8 vs P&L 92.0) is tax including discontinued operations. Adjusted EPS bridge starts at diluted EPS net earnings; eps_items_after_tax_ps includes the discontinued-operations per-share amount (shown as separate 'Less: Discontinued operations' line) so that start + items + discrete = adjusted. 'Acquisition financing interest costs' (0.00 where shown) counted in items. Discrete tax = Calica NOL carryforward valuation allowance. ROIC = TTM Adjusted EBITDA / 5-quarter average invested capital, in percent.
